editorial.blurb: A no-frills Korean BBQ institution where authentic, expertly-prepared meats and banchan steal the show—expect a hectic but genuine experience run by Korean aunties who know their craft.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive well before 9:20 PM (they start clearing by then) and go with a group on a weekday if possible to avoid the Saturday dinner rush; ask the staff to grill your meat tableside and order the banchan early.
